overview_description.description: Arlo Industries develops defense technology focused on passive aerial sensing infrastructure for modern warfare. The company builds distributed optical sensing networks and mesh systems that track drones and missiles in three dimensions without emitting detectable radio or radar signatures. Its systems combine high-performance optics, edge AI computing, and decentralized networking protocols to provide persistent aerial situational awareness. Arlo Industries designs distributed hardware nodes coordinated by software so that resilience comes from network density, adaptability, and redundancy rather than single large emitters. Its technology is intended for defense organizations and critical infrastructure operators facing low-altitude, stealthy, or swarm-based aerial threats. Typical uses include counter-drone operations, missile detection, and airspace security over sensitive facilities and contested environments.
